known_assets: Map 1 runtime wall/floor/stone source images remain the Wikimedia Commons materials recorded in visuals/spaces-lab/index.html.
Map 1 derives atlas.archBacking at runtime from the existing wall material.
Map 4 reuses the existing stone image, re-graded warm/brown into atlas.tunnel and tiled as atlas.tunnelTile. No new remote image dependency was added.
Maps 2, 3 and 5 primarily use procedural world-space materials to avoid stretched textures.
visuals/spaces-lab/assets/checker-grid.svg remains historical/optional and is not loaded by current runtime.
rule: Reuse stable image materials where mapping stays convincing. New reference images define composition/style direction but are not embedded as runtime scene backgrounds. Lighting remains world-space and camera-distance based.
